Quirk Analysis.name: Quirk Analysis
Quirk Analysis.description: Covers: working out how a Quirk works from what is seen, spotting its limits and counters, and using sensing or detection Quirks well. Easy: identifying a common Quirk type. Hard: reading an unfamiliar Quirk mid-fight. Exceptional: predicting a Quirk's hidden condition. Not: knowledge of famous heroes, which is Hero Industry. Primary attribute: Intelligence.
